messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to push the 'slate' deployment tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final checkpoints and signoffs. Changes: routing policy tweak (fallthrough order), batching defaults adjusted, and a safety rollback toggle added.

devin: timeline noted. I'll own smoke + canary (09:35-09:50). Will run the smoke script and validate latency/err rates.

samir: infra reservations done. Snapshot taken: snap-2026-03-17-01. Rollback image staged. I verified the new kernel flags on canaries.

leo: I'm oncall for the window. Docs updated with explicit rollback steps and who to @ in case of DB lock. Please confirm no DB migrations in this deploy.

maria: Checklist (please ack):
- [ ] dev signoff
- [ ] sec signoff
- [ ] smoke pass (canary)
- [ ] monitoring dashboards green
- [ ] rollback validated

devin: dev signoff ✅ — code reviewed, CI green (main -> release branch), unit + integration tests passed.

samir: sec signoff ✅ — quick config audit done, no new ingress rules, KMS policies unchanged.

leo: starting smoke now. Running the standard smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke-check.sh --deploy-id=slate-1890001111 --checks=latency,errors,kv-cache
```
Will post updates in ~10m.

ops-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z. Auto-rollback on failure enabled. Reminder: SLA notifications to #incidents if >5% error spike.

maria: last call — flip in 15m. Any blockers?

devin: no blockers from dev, rolling forward unless told otherwise.

samir: no blockers from infra/security.

leo: canary smoke looks good — 0.4% error (baseline 0.5%), p50/p95 latency steady. Moving to 30% rollout.

devin: canary logs look clean, model routing behaves as expected.

ops-bot: Smoke results: PASS (3/3 checks).

maria: starting gradual rollout now. Watch the dashboards at https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/slate-1890001111 and call out any regressions. :rocket:

devin: 30% -> 70% -> 100% progressed, no regressions observed.

leo: full rollout started. No alerts so far. Recording runbook note: rollback path = snapshot snap-2026-03-17-01 + feature-flag disable routing-change.

samir: rollback artifacts validated and stored.

maria: rollout complete, marking as closed. Great job everyone — thanks for the quick signoffs. :tada:
